clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: Smappee Developer API OAuth2 client id

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: Smappee Developer API OAuth2 client secret

serviceLocationId.title: Service Location ID
serviceLocationId.description: Optional Smappee service location id. Leave 0 to use the first one.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to refresh consumption data (minimum 60).

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the devices will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed. If the list is empty, no devices will be excluded.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging.
